chunks.text: I've taken in what you tell me about the bull prints, and I'm convinced;
but since I was thinking more of the art connoisseurs, who abound in that great capital, and also of the great many people who will have seen them, not counting the Spaniards, I thought it was easy:
by giving them to a print-seller without saying my name, and at a low price, it could have been done.
